validation.metric: median absolute percentage error of monthly totals per country, 2020 to 2025, model learned on 2012 to 2019

notes: Gradient boosting model (ml count-full-careful) that estimates the Suomi NPP count of a cell and month from what MODIS saw, learned on 1,346 cell-months. Where the model has no estimate the ratio method is used. Ratio method: Suomi NPP to MODIS ratio per 1 degree block and calendar month (17 block ratios), falling back to the country's ratio for that calendar month, then the country's overall ratio. Overall ratios: canada 4.59. NOAA-20 handoff ratios: canada 0.970.
